verdict.rationale: The docs describe several background automations. Users can automate workflows with rules, webhooks, and online evaluations. Evaluators run automatically on production traces, with filters and sampling. Threshold-based alerts route to Slack, PagerDuty, or webhooks, and LangSmith Engine automatically detects and diagnoses recurring trace issues. These automations are scoped to observability and evaluation triggers rather than general-purpose jobs. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of automation rules and their actions, scheduled or cron-style automations beyond trace triggers, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the automations run reliably.
